system_prompt_style.note: Only README and a truncated file tree are available. No prompt-assembly code is included. Multica drives external agent CLIs.

env_context_strategy.note: README says projects 'attach the repos and docs agents need as context'. The mechanism code is not in the evidence.

context_compaction.note: This is delegated to the underlying agent CLIs. No harness config surface is in the evidence.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is handled by external CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

protocol_standardization.note: The source could not be grepped because the file tree is truncated.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: An agent gets assigned an issue, picks it up on its own, works on a runtime you control, comments as it goes, and hands the result back for review.
loop_primitives.note: Orchestration layer: issue and cron triggers dispatch tasks over WebSocket to a daemon that spawns agent CLIs. The inner loop belongs to those CLIs.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Put agents and people on one team; the leader routes the work.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default is one agent assigned per issue. Squads (leader routes work) are opt-in, giving an orchestrator_workers topology.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Pick an agent as assignee the way you'd pick a colleague — it takes the work from there.
delegation_mechanism.note: Squad leader routing (role_handoff-like) is reachable but opt-in. The code is not in the evidence.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Work lands in review, not in main. You decide what ships.
human_in_loop.note: The inbox also pings a human when an agent 'needs a call'.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The intent, the run, the decisions, and the diff stay connected to the same issue
short_term_state.note: Issue and task records are stored in PostgreSQL.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Turn a solved problem into a playbook every agent reuses.

self_verification.note: Human review gates are not automated verification.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Failed runs retry on their own, or stop and tell you why.
retry_policy.note: The retry cap is not visible. fixed_n is the closest value.

termination_condition.note: README mentions timeouts, which are coded under F3.

cost_controls.note: Token usage is reported per run ('See what each run cost'). No cap is evidenced.

timeouts.note: README advertises 'Retries and timeouts' but does not state whether the timeout scope is per tool or per run.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Agent runtime | Local daemon executing any of the 26 agent CLIs above
execution_isolation.note: The daemon spawns CLIs on the host machine. Docker is for self-hosting the server, not for agent isolation.

filesystem_access.note: security-model.mdx is listed in the file tree but its content is not provided.

permission_model.note: Member access scopes govern which agents a member can run, not how actions are authorised.

tracing.evidence_quote: Replay every tool call, command, and error, timestamped.

replayability.note: The README's 'replay' refers to viewing the execution log, not re-running a trajectory.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign work to AI coding agents
target_domain.note: Autopilots also run reports and standups.

open_source.evidence_quote: the complete Apache License 2.0 text plus additional conditions covering hosted services, commercial embedding, and branding.
open_source.note: The source is open, but the licence is non-OSI because of the added conditions. partial is the closest value.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Multica does not ship a model. It drives the agent CLIs you already have installed and authenticated
model_agnostic.note: Agnostic at the level of the agent CLI (26 CLIs supported).

first_release_date.note: No first tag or first commit date is in the evidence.

stars.note: No star count is in the evidence.
